risks: Patching applyCalendarWrite/bindCall alone misses the actual CALENDAR_BIND flow, which calls bindCalendarOccurrence and only makes a blocked reminder ledger entry.
Spec describes recurrence completeness but omits WP-29 from explicit edges; mutable scheduled start time must never become occurrence identity.
Shared context/transcript provenance is explicitly gated on WP-50 in the published plan despite no WP-30 explicit edge.
m-* local IDs, meeting-* catalog IDs and call:<id> refs must converge through aliases without broadening filesystem IDs or generating alternate meetings.
Raw colon-delimited occurrence/meeting binding keys can collide on opaque IDs; encoded Rox2 binding helpers already exist, while historical ambiguous keys require quarantine, not heuristic merge.
Legacy handlers use client actor/grant/credentials parameters and infer workspace readability; standalone permissiveness must not leak into authenticated shared authority.
Room handler hardcodes recordingConsent=true and provider is undecided; planned binding cannot be reported as actual room/media success.
One archiveGranted flag or event grant cannot express independent recording/transcript retention ACL; event deletion must not cascade archive destruction or authorization expansion.
Core Meeting lacks time/context fields while LocalMeeting has scalar local times; temporal conversion and schedule-versus-actual ownership need an accepted revisioned contract.
MeetingJournal dedupes commandId without request hash and has standalone file authority; common transactional shared receipts/outbox cannot be replaced by this journal or Maps.
Calls contracts/commands/repository are normative shared files repeated across WP-30..35; two migration identifiers also overlap. Lead must integrate through one owner/migrator.
The inspected MeetingsPage explicitly says catalog/search/detail live on another existing page; a second UI surface would violate scope. Lead must verify mounting before implementing patches.

Normative response.status/receiptId JSON shape differs from existing Rox2CanonicalResult triad, and API names vary across apiChanges/operations/domainApiContracts; use a compiled accepted adapter rather than unsafe casting or extra aliases.
Observed locale directory has 12 JSON catalogs while loaded context mentions 10; root i18n owner must maintain live parity when adding labels.

Existing source-regex/blanket-blocked tests are incidental implementation pins, not live proof. Preserve meaningful provider fail-closed behavior but replace pins with consumer-visible assertions on the cutover path.

All source evidence is from a mutable pre-wave0 tree and file hashes, not a tested delivered revision. This report has no runtime acceptance, provider readiness, dependency receipt or feature-completion authority.
